title: (POSTPONED) Harmonium Workshop
description:
Harmonium - Workshop at Essência

**POSTPONED. Info will follow.**

Harmonium course with mantras and heart songs.

A gentle space to explore sound, voice, and presence through simple melodies and repetition.

Beginner-friendly and open to all levels, whether you are just starting or already familiar with the instrument. We’ll learn the basics of the Indian harmonium, dive into mantras from different traditions, and sing together.

Come as you are, no perfection needed—just a willingness to listen, feel, and express. Let’s chant, connect, and create something beautiful together.

Beginner:  Sunday 5th April 10am - 4pm

Extension:  12th of April. 10am - 4pm

Where:  Essência Nature Retreat, Aljezur

Contribution: €100 / Day incl. Script & Harmonium-Rent.

Sign-Up & Info:  matthuji (at) icloud.com

What to bring: Snacks for your lunch and water. Yourself ❤️

There is a selection of different Indian Harmoniums available to play during the Workshop, if you wish to buy one, i will advice you for the best choice for you.
short_description: POSTPONED. Info will follow. Beginner-friendly harmonium workshop with mantras and simple songs. Explore voice, sound, and presence in a relaxed group setting. Includes basics, instruments provided, and guidance for all levels.
